name: The same long prompt sent without caching

find.note: Prompt caching exists here but is commented out
Prompt caching is a setting here; check its default
Prompt caching is switched off here
A Claude Messages call with no cache_control near it. Claude only caches when the request asks

why: Claude only caches a prompt when the request says so, or when a product's setting is on. Long system prompts and tool lists re-sent every turn pay full price each time. It doesn't fit prompts under the model's minimum length or calls that don't repeat.
judge_note: For this pattern, this replaces the general rule on prompt caching: a Claude Messages call with no cache_control near it, whose system prompt or tool list goes out again turn after turn, is a fit even with no setting in the code, and that call's line is the place to cite. A one-off call with a short prompt is no fit. A line that only builds a client is no fit.
